comparisons.name: panel-light
comparisons.description: The App Store's first editorial card, Aqua: the whole card with its text. The round illustration is Apple's artwork, so its square is masked.

comparisons.name: panel-light-masked
comparisons.description: As panel-light with the three texts masked too, which are set in the fallback font off Apple platforms: scores the card's fill, edges and corners.

comparisons.name: panel-dark
comparisons.description: The App Store's first editorial card, Dark Aqua: the whole card with its text; the illustration's square is masked.

comparisons.name: panel-dark-masked
comparisons.description: As panel-dark with the three texts masked too: scores the card's fill, edges and corners.

comparisons.name: hero-corner-light
comparisons.description: Bottom-left corner of the App Store's hero, Aqua: a flat edge with no shadow and a 6 pt corner. The photograph is replaced by its average colour there, so what is scored is the corner's shape.

comparisons.name: hero-corner-dark
comparisons.description: Bottom-left corner of the App Store's hero, Dark Aqua.

comparisons.name: hero-text-light
comparisons.description: The eyebrow and the two-line title of the App Store's hero, Aqua, over the cloud of the photograph, which the fixture replaces by a gradient: scores where the text stands, in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: hero-text-light-masked
comparisons.description: As hero-text-light with the eyebrow and the title masked: scores the stand-in for the photograph, so that the unmasked comparison's score is the text's.

comparisons.name: hero-text-dark
comparisons.description: The eyebrow and the two-line title of the App Store's hero, Dark Aqua: the text keeps its colours, because it lies on the photograph.

comparisons.name: hero-text-dark-masked
comparisons.description: As hero-text-dark with the eyebrow and the title masked: scores the stand-in for the photograph.

comparisons.name: raised-corner-light
comparisons.description: Bottom-left corner of TV's hero, Aqua: the 12 pt corner, the hairline on both edges, and the shadow below and beside it. Nothing is masked.

comparisons.name: raised-corner-dark
comparisons.description: Bottom-left corner of TV's hero, Dark Aqua. Nothing is masked.

comparisons.name: states-light
comparisons.description: What no screenshot shows, Aqua: a panel that is a button keeps the panel's layout. The disc is a circle at the trailing edge and the title stands at the top, where a plain panel has it.
